title: THE FREQUENCY BENEATH · The book
venue: private · after a paperback found in the library's return cart · Box 26
logline: A paperback on the drafting table, its cover a waveform, its author's name a shape, a library's due-date card in its pocket: a book about a frequency under everything. He read it in a night. The page draws the book and, under the table, the private work's only hum — as a trace this time, not a line.

panels.composition: A paperback with a waveform on its cover lying on a drafting table under the lamp, a library card pocket inside its cover, and beneath the table's edge a thin wavering trace drawn across the page's bottom like an oscilloscope line.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a paperback with a waveform on its cover lying on a drafting table under a lamp with a library card pocket inside the cover, a thin wavering trace drawn across the bottom of the page like an oscilloscope line, no words legible
image.notes: Vol 7: John Frank's The Frequency Beneath. Author and title as shapes. The hum line (canon) becomes a trace here and only here.

art.line: the private line, but ruled: graph paper, waveforms, spectrogram bands drawn by hand
art.palette: ochre and slate; the trace in one warm color
